column1: # eot-pso-set v2: the pipelines the renderer builds ahead of the draws that
# use them. Generated by tools/pso/pso_derive.py from the paks and the
# captures; do not edit. Tab-separated records:
#   core   <id> <pipeline row (header columns): the state; shaders,
#          declaration, strides and polygon offset empty>
#   vkey   <v|p> <key> <hashes>   a shader cache key with several containers:
#          the game keeps the first one loaded, the renderer builds with it
#   cap    <pipeline row>   the merged captures the set was made from
#          (the generator reads them back; not compiled in)
#          pkg: the packages whose load queues the row (|-joined), 0 = the boot;
#          bias 0 none, 1 the material's (m: offset m*1e-5, slope m*2),
#          source c captured (frame: first drawn; tags: the packages it was
#          drawn under; spec: the specialization bits it was drawn with; a
#          derived row's is the alpha-test bit or ff, either),
#          d derived from the pak (likeliest first); msaa: how draws used it
#          under eot_msaa (bit 0 single-sample, bit 1 multisampled, 0 not
#          known: both are built); vkey/pkey: the vkey records of its
#          shaders' cache keys (empty: one container), whose live variant
# 11012 captured pipelines (2 files): 9649 captured rows; 56831 derived from 230 paks; 119 cores, 110 declarations
# shadow offsets: 497 over 169 rooms (386 from the paks' ShadowMapInitializers and the global one)
# held-out levels: 3494/4935 drawn material pipelines predicted (70.8%; 92.0% with the live shader variants), 24611 derived for those paks
# 4 states with a motion-vector form; rows by msaa use: 0 8443, 1 28577, 2 4600, 3 24860
